description: Prepare claiming an LP vault's bonus (what a defaulted LP loan's sale brought above its book value, shared by the lenders by their share of the vault and the time they held it while the loan ran), every loan with one when loanId is omitted. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

loanId.description: The defaulted LP loan whose bonus to claim; every loan of the vault with a bonus for this wallet when omitted

vault.description: An LP vault: one gage_lp_vaults lists (the manifest's, or one a curator opened through the lane's factory)

name: gage_prepare_lp_claim_bonus
title: Prepare: Claim an LP vault's bonus
